reuse.why: Extends the existing isOffDay predicate, which every schedule path already uses for holiday checks, via a small isHoliday helper.

duplication.why: The matching rule is defined once; only the occurrence-window padding in getUpcomingDates is adjusted with its own ad-hoc formula while the paddings in getNextDate and getDatesInRange are left on the old one.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts beside isOffDay, the module that owns weekend/holiday logic.

scope.why: One helper, one margin tweak and a test; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Clear and centralised matching, though the `(Math.ceil(count / 200) + 1)` multiplier is an unexplained magic number that makes the three window paddings diverge.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All holiday checks keep going through isOffDay.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated; the recurring-day match is added inside the shared predicate.
